answer: About 200 milliseconds, a fifth of a second.

title: The Morse code drawn in sand that scans your milk
recall: What did Norman Joseph Woodland borrow from Morse code?
answer: The idea of short and long marks, stretched into thin and thick lines.

title: A 99% alarm that is right 17% of the time
recall: A spam filter catches 95% of spam and wrongly flags 2% of good mail. If 1 mail in 100 is spam, is a flagged mail more likely spam or good?
answer: Among 10,000 mails, 95 spam are caught and 198 good ones are flagged, so a flagged mail is more likely good (about 32% spam).

title: The rice that survives the pot
recall: What is the name of the bacterium, and what is a spore?
answer: Bacillus cereus. A spore is a tough, dormant shell that survives cooking and wakes when conditions are warm and wet.
